Name: Barcelona El Prat T1
Tips: 21:50 landing. Two checked bags at the carousel - reckon on reaching the apartment ~23:00. Guard bags from the kerb onward, the airport and its Metro line are prime pickpocket turf. Taxi rank outside T1 arrivals is the right call tonight, ~25 min door-to-door. Aerobus A1 to Plaça Catalunya is 7.45 EUR/pp + a taxi hop.

Name: AB Sagrada Família Bofill
Address: Carrer de la Marina 240, Eixample, 08013 Barcelona
Tips: ~22:45 check-in, reception open to 00:00. TOURIST TAX IS PAYABLE HERE AT CHECK-IN and is NOT in the Booking.com total - Catalonia IEET plus Barcelona surcharge, roughly 6-7 EUR per person per night for a tourist apartment (confirm the exact rate with them), about 120-140 EUR for 5 nights x 4. Under-16s exempt. Ask whether they take card or want cash. If TP1038 runs late, call the hotel from Lisbon so they hold the desk. Passports back in the safe EXCEPT they come out tomorrow for the Sagrada Família.

Name: Late bite on Av. Gaudí / C. de la Marina
Tips: 23:00 - Eixample keeps late kitchens, tapas counters and granja-style cafés serving until midnight. Worst case the doner/pizza counters near the basilica never close. Keep it light.

Name: Sagrada Família (floodlit at night)
Tips: First-night orientation freebie - the basilica is floodlit at night and it is a 4-minute stroll. If anyone has legs left, the first sight of those towers against the dark sky beats any tapa.
